dimensions.description: Blindly compare whether the complete consumer uses bounded candidate judgments to produce independently verifiable vertical slices or concrete prerequisites and rejects a convenience foundation. Quote or reference output evidence for every score.
Assess whether Slice Plan retains set-level reconciliation while Ticket Scope contributes only one-candidate judgments. Quote or reference output evidence for every score.

evals.name: candidate-scope-component
evals.prompt: Decompose settled account time-zone requirements into one-context tickets. Candidate proposals include a shared-interface foundation with no direct consumer-visible or prerequisite result, a schema prerequisite, and an API vertical slice. Return a ready internal plan without tracker writes.
evals.expected_output: The complete consumer invokes Ticket Scope for bounded judgments, rejects the convenience foundation, and reconciles the candidate set into complete independently verifiable tickets.
expectations: Both arms receive the same neutral planning task; only the Ticket Scope dependency load differs.
The blind judge assesses candidate quality and responsibility boundaries rather than exact wording.
Missing production dependencies are not component controls.
Semantic scoring quotes or references concrete output evidence; sampled human review checks the candidate seams.
